name: Analysis panel loads without intrusive external popups or overlays
description: Opening the Analysis tab should not trigger any external cookie consent overlays, advertisement popups, or promotional modals that obscure the analysis content.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match cell to open a match detail page
Click the Analysis tab and wait for the panel to fully load

Verify the analysis panel content is readable without any intrusive overlay, popup, or modal covering it. The analysis paragraphs should be accessible and the page should not be obscured by third-party popups.
